news.headline: Severe eczema more than doubles shingles risk (new UK study)
news.summary: 2.4M-patient UK cohort: atopic dermatitis raises shingles risk 28% — 2.3× in severe disease, and highest in adults 30–40; a shareable heads-up for her eczema audience.
news.her_angle: If you have moderate-to-severe eczema, the shingles-vaccine talk may matter well before 50.
news.source: AJMC / JDDG (J der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft)
